newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market picked up on a dip in the dollar and calls for a firmer Chicago soymeal futures opening, dealers said.

"There was little faith in the market after prices here rose some $4 on a firmer overnight Chicago's. This morning most buyers stayed sidelined, due to the higher prices levels, a stronger dollar and uncertainty what Chicago futures would do. When the dollar dipped well under 1.70 marks and Chicago futures were called around $1 up some decided to buy nearby Brazilian soymeal, Thai tapioca and EU rapemeal," one broker said.
Brazilian soymeal pellets traded around $4 up from yesterday between $324 and $318 a tonne cif Rotterdam from several vessels. Arrived Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $154 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
Spot Thai hard tapioca pellets changed hands at 19.25 marks per 100 kg fob Amsterdam and 19.40 fob Ghent. Afloat material traded at 19.35 marks fob Rotterdam, up 0.10 marks from yesterday.

EU rapemeal traded at 30.75 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine for week 20+21 delivery and week 22 delivery fetched 30.50 marks. June traded at 30.25 marks fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
